本的生活方式(Ben's Way of Living): 一篇关于运动健身的B1记叙文:本的经历、感受与成长。

On Wednesday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. Max and Ben are preparing a report about the bike lane. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. For example, respite care gave her a weekend off.
Little by little, things began to change. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The experience taught Ben more than any book could. They walked towards the sunset.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. People around Ben often share different ideas about the bike lane. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The timid rabbit hid under the garden bush.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The bike lane looked quieter than usual that evening. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What's more, the upshot of the meeting was a shorter work week.
Ben has practiced chess for three years and won a prize last term. Ben keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
